decisions.reason: As a 2023 handle family still listed in 2024, it appears to retain enough market relevance that its low carrying cost and fit with the firm's broad architectural range make keeping the option more valuable than exiting now.

Its move from a mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests strengthening prospects, so management would likely continue backing this multifunctional variant while demand and specification potential develop further.

This line remains on the website but without stronger proof points than continued listing, so it faces some pruning risk, yet as a relatively low-cost extension of the core door hardware portfolio it is still more likely to be retained.
